perplexity.description:
Paul Draper's album Cult Leader Tactics, released on January 28, 2022, through the Kscope label, is a rock record infused with art-rock and electronic elements. It serves as Draper's second solo studio album following his 2017 debut Spooky Action. The album is a satirical exploration of self-help culture, using sharp wit and a Machiavellian lens to critique the pursuit of success by any means necessary. Musically, it blends fuzz bass, space rock, rhythmic funk, and lush, synth-driven textures reminiscent of 1980s art-pop, with Draper himself performing most instruments alongside producer Paul Walton.

Cult Leader Tactics features notable collaborations, including Steven Wilson, who co-wrote and contributed to the track "Omega Man," reflecting shared feelings of isolation during lockdown. The album also includes string arrangements by Gamaliel Rendle Traynor and a 288-person choir assembled remotely for the closing track "Lyin’ Bout Who U Sleep With," adding depth and variety to the sound palette. Critically, the album was praised for its clever lyricism and vibrant musicality, continuing Draper's reputation as a distinctive voice in British rock. Commercially, it reached number 22 on the UK Albums Chart and maintained a presence for one week, marking a solid follow-up to his debut solo effort.
